description:
Get every company that filed a matching BSE announcement in a trailing window, market-wide.

    `bucket` is one of the ids from list_announcement_buckets (e.g. "order-receipts",
    "fundraise"). `days` (1..90, default 7) bounds the trailing window over filing date. Returns
    newest first across the WHOLE universe (not one security). Metadata only — the raw disclosed
    subject/headline plus a link to the source BSE filing; no PDF parsing, no verdicts. Capped
    at 200 rows; `truncated: true` means more announcements matched the window than were
    returned (narrow `days` to see the rest) — `total_scanned` reports the true match count,
    uncapped. Each event carries its `news_id` — pass it to get_filing_extract for that filing's
    extracted facts.
name: get_announcement_bucket
